prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / identity-preserve. Asset type: one transparent game dialogue portrait, intended logical grid exactly 74 pixels wide by 100 pixels high. Draw a completely new tight portrait from the supplied original character identity, translating into the serious, coarse pixel-art visual language of the approved portrait references.
Composition: very tight head crop, complete crown with only one or two logical pixels of transparent top margin, full jaw kept, head/face fills almost the entire canvas. Show just a small collar or shawl sliver along the bottom. No chest expanse, no full body, no hands. Natural mature adult skull and eyes, not chibi and not a child.
Style: coarse logical pixels and hard stair-step silhouettes. Prioritize about 4 to 6 large connected shape masses per material; large flat terracotta skin light/midtone/shadow planes. Strong readable nose wings and cheekbone planes. Selective deep-brown outline and internal separators. Small mature horizontal eyes with dark irises and tiny muted warm-cream slivers, no large bright eye-white blocks. Fewer than 32 working colors. No gradient, blur, painterly softness, antialiasing, dithering, noisy specks, scattered bright single-pixel highlights or finely drawn hair strands. If the tool needs a larger canvas, draw as an integer-style enlargement of the coarse 74x100 logical pixel image.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent alpha outside silhouette. One portrait only, no text, lettering, labels, frame, decorative background, scenery or symbols.
Input image roles: Image 1 is Ena's old full-body identity reference; use its clothing, brown hair and anxious dignity, but replace the chibi anatomy and huge cartoon eyes with an adult portrait. Image 2 is Mara's approved style and close framing reference only; do not copy her face, red scarf or hair. Image 3 is Leiya's approved tight coarse-pixel style reference only; do not copy her square jaw or blue shawl.
Subject: Ena (NPC-N-ENA), a woman in her mid-thirties from a poor embankment worker's household, wife of the injured living winch repairer Nara. She is a distinct person from the other same-named MAE-S03 Ena. Weathered warm skin, medium-long oval face with a modest squared lower jaw, distinct softly broad nose with readable nostril wings, slightly hollow tired cheeks, dark under-eye planes from waiting for news, slight crease beside the mouth. Brown eyes are alert but weary and look a little to viewer-left. Central brows are gently raised and drawn together; lips closed and held firmly, tension rather than crying or sweet smiling. Preserve quiet toughness and practical worry, not grief theatrics.
Costume and hair invariants: plain aged warm cream/linen headscarf covering the back of her hair, simple side knot visible but not giant; a few broad irregular brown forelock masses at forehead and temples, no long loose strands. The wedding-keepsake old shawl and plain brown outerwear remain visible as a small collar-width lower edge, with modest old wear; cloth is everyday fabric, not luxurious or ceremonial. Any previously held coat, folded papers, apron hands or body props stay outside the portrait crop.
Story constraints: do not declare her husband dead, compensated, returned to work, or recovered. No mourning veil, tears, cash, jewelry, halo, corpse imagery, address, text or story outcome. Do not turn this into Mara's same face.
